page.layout: Decorative woodcut ornament at the top, without text. Below it, a centred dedication heading in capitals with the author's name in italics beneath. Then one column of running text with a woodcut initial at the left. Marginal notes stand in the right margin. A signature mark sits at the bottom centre. No running head, catchword or page number.

main_text.head: ILLUSTRISSIMO COMITI ESSEXIÆ, ROBERTO DEUREUXO, Iohannes Rainoldus S.
main_text.p: CUM multa sunt, ut nosti, Comes illustrissime, quæ fructus lætos uberesque ferunt reipublicæ, si diligenter excolantur: tum nihil ampliores, quàm vera pietas & religio. Nam Deus, & promissis, non modo Ios. 1.8.{a}Io-suæ factis, sed etiam Psal.1.3.{b}toti Ecclesiæ, pros-peratum iri omnes qui de Lege ipsius meditantur interdiu ac noctu, ut observent ea quæ scripta sunt, cõfirmat, & Iud. 2.14. 1.Sam.12. 11.[?]{c}exemplis populi sui ostendit, secundos dari rerum successus perseverantibus in sancto Dei cul-2.Reg.17.7.tu, adversos declinatibus ad idololatriam. Quod perspectu habens vir omnium virtutum luminibus ornatissimus, Franciscus Vvalsinghamus, curavit pro eximia, qua tum Academiam Oxoniensem publice, tum me privatim est complexus, benevolentia & amore, ut extraordinarius con-troversiarum adversus Pontificiæ super-

page.notes: Printed "Vvalsinghamus" transcribed as printed. Section of the "1.Sam.12." note: the "11." under it is set lower and is uncertain. Long s is printed as f in several places and was rendered as s. The "2.Reg.17.7." note has no letter mark in the text. No running head, catchword or page number is printed on this page. Show-through from the reverse is ignored.
